source: Independent source-informed runtime organized into an execution engine, geometry, movement, placement selection and visibility modules. No upstream runtime is included. Public declarations and original tests retain MIT attribution; this is not a clean-room claim.
scope: Full core 1.8.0 exported API, focused on the offset/flip/shift/limitShift pipelines used by VentiMath Tiptap popovers, dropdowns and tooltips. The DOM adapter is now independently implemented in vfloating-ui-dom; the React caller remains separate.

implementation.targetScope: computePosition, detectOverflow and all published core middleware on vfloating-ui-utils.

changes: Capture middleware names and functions before asynchronous platform measurement; caller mutations cannot append or replace the active execution plan.
Retain inherited platform methods when adding the default overflow hook, and honor the custom platform.detectOverflow API added in core 1.8.
Store middleware data as own properties even for __proto__; names cannot replace the result dictionary prototype.

Use iterative bounding-box accumulation and linear placement ranking rather than argument spreading and sorting temporary candidate lists. The 150,000-rect control exceeds the upstream argument limit on Node; Bun can already handle that control.
Retain upstream reset limits, empty-inline handling and current placement/RTL/overflow/middleware contracts.

verification.upstream: 27 unchanged upstream tests, TypeScript 7 transpilation, import resolution shims and strict Node assertions for the used matchers.
verification.parity: 624 generated positioning cases compare all middleware against core 1.8.0 on Node 24/Bun, with custom overflow hooks, scales, resets and app-used configurations.
verification.browser: 144 Chrome cases run real DOM 1.8.0 with upstream core/utils versus VPM core/utils, including app pipelines, arrows, automatic placement, sizing, hiding and inline positioning; overflow, shadow slots, iframe and modal checks also pass.
verification.packaging: Packed core/utils npm and Bun consumers, Node/Bun CJS/ESM, browser bundles and TypeScript 7 declarations.
